readerCopy.body: A strong case for what is already known can make an unfamiliar option look weaker simply because it still contains more unanswered questions. When Mercury opposes the North Node, familiar expertise and forward movement face each other directly, giving settled opinions and established explanations an advantage because they are easier to defend. Existing knowledge still matters. It becomes limiting when no new information is allowed to change the conclusion.
